title: 第一卷 第18章 古卷秘力，灵药提纯
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
苏玄尘抬起枯瘦却稳健的手掌，轻轻拂过眼前这片被清冷月色笼罩的山谷。

    随着他手掌的挥动，整片山谷内散发着淡淡荧光的月华草，仿佛受到了某种无形的牵引。

    连根拔起，尽数飞入他的掌心。

    数十株月华草在掌心堆积，根系完整，叶片饱满，药力完好无损。

    一股清冽幽淡的草木香气瞬间四溢开来，在这寂静的林间显得格外诱人。

    月华草，这种在修仙界颇为常见的灵草，最擅长滋养经脉、凝练灵力。

    对于炼气低层的修士而言，无疑是极佳的修炼辅助灵药。

    然而，寻常弟子得到此草，大多只是粗鲁地嚼碎吞服。

    那样做虽然简单直接，但药力粗糙且狂暴，吸收极其缓慢，大半珍贵的药力都会随着代谢白白浪费。

    但苏玄尘不同，他拥有那卷逆天的古书在手！

    他警惕地环顾四周，林间寂静无声，只有偶尔的风吹树叶沙沙作响。

    确认无人路过后，他身形一闪，迅速退入密林深处，寻得一处极为隐蔽的枯木树洞。

    确认四周绝对安全、无人窥探后，他立刻从怀中取出了那本贴身收藏的古朴书卷。

    泛黄的书页在昏暗的树洞中摊开，一股古朴苍茫的气息内敛沉寂，仿佛亘古存在。

    外人提纯灵药，往往需要借助丹炉与烈火，且只能提纯丹药。

    唯有他的这卷古书，可提纯一切天材地宝！

    苏玄尘神色平静，将十株月华草轻轻铺于书页之上，随后缓缓合拢书卷。

    无需任何晦涩的口诀，也无需耗费自身的灵力催动。

    仅仅三息静默。

    “嗡——”

    书页微微震颤，一缕淡金色的流光悄然流转于纸面之上，仿佛在进行着某种玄奥的转化。
content_en:
Su Xuanchen raised his thin but steady palm and gently brushed it across the valley shrouded in the cold moonlight.

    As he waved his palm, the moonflower grass in the entire valley was emitting light fluorescence, as if it was being pulled by some invisible force.

    Uprooted and all flew into his palm.

    Dozens of moongrass plants are piled up in the palm of your hand, with intact root systems, full leaves, and intact medicinal power.

    A clear and faint scent of grass and trees instantly overflowed, making it particularly attractive in this silent forest.

    Moonflower grass, this kind of spiritual grass that is quite common in the world of immortality, is best at nourishing meridians and condensing spiritual power.

    For monks at the lower levels of Qi refining, it is undoubtedly an excellent auxiliary elixir for training.

    However, when ordinary disciples get this herb, most of them just chew it and swallow it roughly.

    Although it is simple and direct, the medicinal power is rough and violent, and the absorption is extremely slow. Most of the precious medicinal power will be wasted through metabolism.

    But Su Xuanchen is different. He has that heaven-defying ancient book in his hand!

    He looked around warily. The forest was silent except for the occasional rustle of leaves in the wind.

    After confirming that no one was passing by, he quickly retreated into the depths of the dense forest and found an extremely hidden hole in a dead tree.

    After confirming that the surroundings were absolutely safe and no one was prying, he immediately took out the ancient book he had kept close to his chest.

    The yellowed pages of the book were spread out in the dim tree hole, and there was a simple and vast atmosphere that was restrained and silent, as if it existed from ancient times.

    When outsiders purify elixirs, they often need to use alchemy furnaces and fire, and they can only purify elixirs.

    Only his ancient book can purify all heavenly materials and earthly treasures!

    With a calm expression, Su Xuanchen gently spread ten pieces of moonflower grass on the pages of the book, and then slowly closed the book.

    There is no need for any obscure formulas, and there is no need to expend your own spiritual energy to stimulate it.

    Just three breaths of silence.

    "Buzz——"

    The pages of the book trembled slightly, and a ray of pale golden light flowed quietly on the paper, as if undergoing some mysterious transformation.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 18 The Secret Power of the Ancient Scroll and the Purification of the Spiritual Medicine
